messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Spike in notification failures detected for notifications-service -> provider: sendgrid (500s) and twilio (gateway timeout). Root agg: 45% delivery failures over 10m. Paging dev-oncall.

maria_gonzalez: seeing same in dashboards. Failed send rate jumped at 14:02 UTC, correlates with increased 5xx from sendgrid-east-1. Twilio shows sporadic 524s.

devon_h: I'm on it. Toggling enhanced logging for notifications-service to capture outbound payloads and provider response headers. Adding temporary debug sampling.

sarah_ops: notif-slo-alerts triggered a page. Customer impact: verification emails and OTP SMSes delayed or not delivered. Early estimate: ~3% of auth flows failing end-to-end; some at higher rates for EU region.

maria_gonzalez: checking support queue — several tickets and live chats about "didn't get code" in last 20m. Escalating to support lead.

pagerduty-bot: devon_h acknowledged the incident (oncall). Estimated time to engage provider: 3-5m.

devon_h: quick mitigation plan: 1) enable retries with exponential backoff on failed provider calls (already queued). 2) switch non-critical transactional emails to backup provider (mailgun) for a short window. 3) enable SMS fallback to Twilio's alternate region, and allow resend UI for 2FA flows. Executing step 1 now.

sarah_ops: note — don't switch all sends to backup immediately; need rate-limit guard to avoid tripping mailgun. I'll coordinate quota.

maria_gonzalez: running a dry run on mailgun routing for a few test addresses. If success, we'll route verification emails only.

devon_h: deployed retry patch (hotfix) to notifications-service in prod-canary. Config: retries=3, backoff=200ms->800ms, circuit-breaker threshold=30s. Monitoring.

sarah_ops: @todd_support can you prepare a canned customer-facing line for status page and CS? Something like: "We're investigating delivery delays with our email/SMS providers; you may experience delayed verification codes. We recommend using 'resend code' while we mitigate." Keep it short.

todd_support: on it. Drafting message now and pushing to status.redwood.ai/incidents. Will include ETA unknown until providers confirm.

maria_gonzalez: mailgun test send succeeded for 5 samples. Provider headers show accepted (202). Switching verification emails to mailgun via feature-flag for 10% traffic to start.

devon_h: enabling flag for verification email route to use mailgun (10% -> 50% -> 100% ramp if stable). Observability: rate of sendgrid 5xx is decreasing slightly but still present. Twilio still intermittent 524s.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: devon_h -> maria_gonzalez at 14:25 UTC. devon remains available for pager escalation.

maria_gonzalez: taking over. Current state: email verification partial failover to mailgun (10%). Retry hotfix live. SMS still showing 20% failures in eu-west. Reached out to Twilio support + attached logs.

todd_support: status page updated. Customers informed: "We are experiencing delivery issues affecting verification codes for some users. We're actively mitigating; you can try 'resend code' and we will notify when services are restored."

devon_h: dug into notification logs — a subset of requests to Twilio are getting long TCP handshakes before timeout. Could be provider-side network degradation or an intermediate peering issue. Filed a ticket with Twilio support (case #TW-97231) and shared PCAP and headers.

maria_gonzalez: CS asks about bulk resend for affected orgs — plan: provide an admin-triggered resend job that enqueues retries up to N. Is that safe?

devon_h: yes, create a backfill job that reads recent failed events (last 30m) and re-enqueues to notifications-service with mailgun for emails and Twilio fallback region for SMS. Add rate-limit at org-level. I can code quick patch.

todd_support: prepping customer comms for enterprise customers: include suggested workaround (resend, mobile app push if enabled) and point to contact channel.

maria_gonzalez: Twilio responded: investigating but seeing elevated latency from eu-pop. Their mitigation: routing traffic away from affected POP; ETA unclear. They've asked for request IDs. Forwarded logs.

devon_h: pushed backfill job to prod with conservative rate limits (5 r/s per org). Starting with orgs that reported highest impact. Monitoring for duplicate deliveries.

oncall-bot: automation: alert suppression enabled for notifications-service to prevent noise. Remaining alerts will still page on error rate >15% after 10m.

sarah_ops: quick customer impact tally: 42 orgs reported failures in last 30m, ~1200 end users affected. Most are verification flows; a handful are transactional marketing emails — those were deprioritized in routing.

maria_gonzalez: backfill successes: 78% of re-enqueued email verification attempts completed via mailgun in first 10m. SMS backfills to twilio-alt show 60% delivery for enqueued ones so far.

todd_support: updated enterprise customers with interim status and that automated resends are being processed. No PII exposed; only delivery metadata.

devon_h: next steps: keep mailgun routing until sendgrid returns to normal 5xx baseline; continue Twilio escalation and keep SMS fallback region active. Postmortem owners: devon_h (root cause/user impact), maria_gonzalez (mitigation timeline & runbook), todd_support (customer comms).

maria_gonzalez: logging a follow-up to schedule post-incident retro and update the notification provider playbook (include immediate failover to mailgun and a tested SMS-alt region).

pagerduty-bot: incident annotated as "notifications-third-party-degradation". Severity set to Sev2. Incident started 1790123456.

sarah_ops: thanks team. I'll leave the channel open for updates. If any org reports missed critical verifications after backfill, escalate to oncall immediately.

todd_support: closing the immediate customer-facing update; will reopen if provider gives full restore or degrades further.

maria_gonzalez: Twilio just replied: mitigation in place, some queues draining; advised monitoring for 30-60m. I'll update when they confirm.

devon_h: monitoring looks good for emails. Twilio metrics trending towards normal but we'll keep SMS fallback active until 15m of stable metrics.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: maria_gonzalez -> todd_support at 14:48 UTC for customer ops watch. devon_h remains engineering point.

sarah_ops: last note — capture which orgs used mailgun fallback to reconcile billing/credits. Also add explicit flag to disable auto-fallback per org (enterprise customers may opt out).

maria_gonzalez: noted. Starting incident write-up now. Will include timelines, tickets (TW-97231 / SG-8842), and actions taken.

todd_support: thanks all. Stand down for now unless new pages. :white_check_mark:
